name: Lonely Lights
source:
Lonely Lights stars British Exchange student Nik, who's attending MGU's photography program. Nik's social anxiety has kept him from truly exploring all that MGU has to offer, and when he nearly fails an assignment because of it - he realises that the upcoming charity concert is the perfect place to get the photos he needs to pass.

The only problem is... Leo is the headlining act for the concert. Nik's celebrity crush for as long as he can remember. Will he be able to get past his crippling anxiety... Or will his journey at MGU end here?

[From [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/lonely-lights]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Lonely Lights》的主角是就读于MGU摄影专业的英国交换生尼克。严重的社交焦虑让他始终未能真正体验MGU丰富多彩的校园生活；而在因此险些挂掉一门课程作业后，他意识到即将举行的慈善演唱会正是拍到及格所需照片的绝佳机会。

唯一的问题在于……这场演唱会的压轴主咖正是利奥——尼克自记事起便一直暗恋的名人偶像。他究竟能否克服令人窒息的焦虑症……还是说他在MGU的求学之旅将就此画上句号？

[摘自[url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/lonely-lights]itch.io[/url]]
